overview_description.description:
HireArt is an online recruitment platform that engages in the pre-screening process for suitable job seekers. It improves the job candidate's pre-screening process by creating online interviews that simulate a real job. 

The candidates are asked to complete tasks that are similar to what they would encounter on the job (e.g., give a presentation, do an excel analysis, give feedback). They record their responses over video or submit text answers and attachments, giving employers higher quality information on which to base hiring decisions.

It was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in New York, United States.

about_short_description.short_description: HireArt is a single platform to hire, employ, and manage a contract workforce.

product.name: Employer of Record
product.description: A service that employs contract workers on behalf of clients, handling payroll, compliance, and benefits to ensure legal employment.

product.name: On-Demand Sourcing
product.description: A talent sourcing service that connects companies with pre-vetted candidates and staffing vendors to fill contract roles quickly and cost-effectively.

product.name: Vendor Management
product.description: Software and services to track, manage, and gain visibility into contract workers, staffing vendors, and related spend.

product.name: Worker Classification
product.description: A compliance service that automates and manages the classification of workers as employees or independent contractors to reduce legal risks.

product.name: Program Management
product.description: End-to-end management of contract workforce programs including recruitment, onboarding, compliance, and offboarding.

product.name: Freelancer Management
product.description: A tool to manage freelancers alongside W2 contract workers within a single platform, including onboarding, payment, and compliance.
